root_cause.text: An integer overflow occurs in `nouveau_gem_pushbuf_reloc_apply()` because the addition of the 32-bit unsigned `r->reloc_bo_offset` and the integer literal `4` is performed in 32-bit arithmetic, allowing the bounds check against the buffer object size to be bypassed when the value wraps around.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `r->reloc_bo_offset + 4` was changed to `(u64)r->reloc_bo_offset + 4` to prevent the 32-bit unsigned addition from wrapping around before comparing it to `nvbo->bo.base.size`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Cast the relocation offset to a 64-bit integer to prevent integer overflow during buffer object boundary validation.
intent_record.what: The code casts the `r->reloc_bo_offset` variable to a 64-bit unsigned integer (`u64`) before performing an addition and comparison.
intent_record.how: This prevents a potential integer overflow bypass of the boundary check when `r->reloc_bo_offset` is near its maximum value, ensuring relocation stays within the buffer bounds.

grouping_result.intent: Cast the relocation offset to a 64-bit integer to prevent integer overflow during buffer object boundary validation.
